record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: promote-writers
    kind: invariant-violation
    expected: A promoted idea carries the effort, and the phase ref when a phase exists; R8 says init supersedes with the new effort.
    observed: init promotes with effort only after creating placeholder phases, so the phase ref stays empty on the init path.
    severity: judgment
  - task: engage-idea-input
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: The idea's effort becomes the focus without running step 3.
    observed: The idea step comes after step 3 with no entry condition that skips step 3.
    severity: minor
  - task: engage-idea-input
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: The routing line carries the idea subject; a closed effort is reopened.
    observed: No text sets idea to the subject; the idea path bypasses the closed-goal reopen rule.
    severity: minor
  - task: engage-idea-input
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: An idea with an effort always becomes a new phase promoted in settle-phase.
    observed: Step 5 skip rules can bypass settle-phase and leave the idea unpromoted.
    severity: minor
  - task: promote-writers
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: A promote happens only on an idea that is still open.
    observed: init and settle-phase do not re-check status open before the supersede.
    severity: minor
integration:
  interfaces: engage reads the idea and carries it; init promotes with effort; settle-phase promotes with effort and phase.
  assumptions: canon supersede merges the payload; promoted and dismissed ideas stay in state active.
  invariants: engage writes nothing on the idea path PASS; valid effort ref at supersede time PASS; phase ref on the init path NOT MET.
  conflicts: R8 (effort only) vs the phase-ref invariant on the init path.
record.subject: engage-from-idea-review
